title: Rastgele Menü Navigasyonu
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Randomly click through different menu items and navigation links. Click on at least 5 different sections. Note any errors, broken pages, or unexpected behavior. Report any 500 errors or blank pages.
expectedOutcome: All navigation links work without server errors or blank pages

title: Form Sınır Değer Testi
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Find any form (search, filter, or creation form). Test edge cases: enter very long text (200+ characters), enter special characters (<script>alert('xss')</script>), enter empty values. Verify the application handles these gracefully.
expectedOutcome: Application handles edge case inputs gracefully without crashes or XSS vulnerabilities

title: Hızlı Çoklu Tıklama Testi
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Find a button or action that might cause issues with double-clicking (like save, submit, or delete). Click it rapidly multiple times. Verify the application handles duplicate submissions gracefully.
expectedOutcome: Rapid clicking does not cause duplicate records or application errors
